In my own log-space fits, mixing L with plain ε brought the residual down to about 6e-8, but the 10-parameter version I could score only reached 1.7e-05, so the exact structure is still missing.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    lt = np.log(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*lt + p[2]*T + p[3]*T**2 + (p[4] + p[5]*lt + p[6]*T)*L + (p[7] + p[8]*T)*L**2 + p[9]*L**3
    return np.exp(z)
